name: Nidorino (CobbleEffort form)
look: a charcoal beast with spiky head fur, a big round peach-lined ear, a translucent quartz horn, an orange-gold eye, an open mouth with white fangs, a dark-red chest plate and glowing magma patches
entry: Its quartz horn grows from a seam of magma in its skull and glows when it charges. It picks fights with anything bigger than itself, and the scorch marks on the rocks show where it won.
how: Wild: rare in badlands, savannas and volcanic biomes.
Evolves into the CobbleEffort Nidoking when you use a Moon Stone on it.
